newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila steps up crackdown on illegal phone users.
newsitem.headline: Manila steps up crackdown on illegal phone users.

text.p: The Philippine National Telecommunications Commission said on Monday it will intensify its drive against the sale and use of smuggled high-powered cordless telephones.
NTC head Simeon Kintanar told reporters that users of these phones illegally tap into frequencies assigned to legitimate users such as mobile phone operators authorised by the NTC.
"We will really push through with this drive since if left unchecked, these illegal frequency users will sabotage the nation's frequency system," Kintanar said.

Kintanar said the NTC with the National Bureau of Investigation and the Philippine National Police recently confiscated a total of 3.0 million pesos worth of illegal phone equipment smuggled from Taiwan.
He said police had raided 15 business establishments selling the units on the Philippines' main northern island of Luzon.
